categories.title: Cleansers
categories.tagline: Every good routine starts with clean skin.
categories.intro: Cleansing removes sunscreen, makeup, oil and the day's pollution so everything you apply next can actually reach your skin. The right cleanser leaves skin fresh and comfortable — never tight.

benefits.title: A clean base
benefits.text: Removes what sits on the surface so serums and creams absorb better.

benefits.title: Balanced
benefits.text: pH-balanced formulas that respect your skin barrier.

benefits.title: For your skin type
benefits.text: A cream for dry or sensitive skin, a gel with salicylic acid for oily skin.

howTo.title: Wet your face
howTo.text: Use lukewarm water — hot water can dry the skin.

howTo.title: A pea-sized amount
howTo.text: Massage gently for 30–60 seconds, including the hairline and jaw.

howTo.title: Rinse and pat dry
howTo.text: Rinse well and pat, don't rub, with a soft towel.

howTo.title: Morning and night
howTo.text: At night, cleanse twice if you wore sunscreen or makeup.

categories.tip: If your skin feels tight after cleansing, your cleanser is too strong.

captions.text: 1  Wet your face with lukewarm water
captions.say: Splash your face with lukewarm water.

[8-12s] Close-up of her cheek as she massages the cleanser in slow gentle circles into a soft creamy lather, then rinses with a splash of water. [12-15s] The ARDEA cleanser tube stands upright on its champagne-gold cap on wet travertine beside the basin, fresh water droplets beading on it, a small splash nearby, slow gentle push-in, ARDEA lettering crisp.

categories.title: Serums
categories.tagline: Concentrated care for what your skin needs right now.
categories.intro: A serum is the most targeted step of a routine: a lightweight formula with a high concentration of one or two key ingredients, made to absorb fast and work under your moisturizer. Pick it by what you want to see change.

benefits.title: Targeted
benefits.text: Each serum focuses on one goal — shine, dark spots, hydration, fine lines or redness.

benefits.title: Lightweight
benefits.text: Water-light textures that absorb in seconds and layer under any cream or sunscreen.

benefits.title: Concentrated
benefits.text: Higher levels of active ingredients than a moisturizer, so a few drops go a long way.

howTo.title: Start clean
howTo.text: Apply after cleansing, on skin that is dry or slightly damp.

howTo.title: 2–3 drops
howTo.text: Release a few drops into your palm or onto your fingertips — more product doesn't mean better results.

howTo.title: Press, don't rub
howTo.text: Gently press over face and neck and let it absorb for 30 seconds.

howTo.title: Seal it in
howTo.text: Follow with your moisturizer — and sunscreen in the morning.

categories.tip: Using more than one? Vitamin C in the morning, retinal at night, and hyaluronic or centella any time.

captions.say: Two or three drops into your palm.
Press gently over face and neck. Don't rub.
Then seal it in with your moisturizer.

video.shots: [0-4s] Close-up of a woman's hands on a travertine bathroom counter in warm morning light, unscrewing the champagne-gold dropper of the ARDEA serum bottle shown in the reference image. [4-8s] Macro shot: the glass pipette releases two or three clear drops into her open palm. [8-12s] Soft close-up of her cheek and jawline as she gently presses the serum into her skin with her fingertips, calm and unhurried, skin glowing naturally. [12-15s] The ARDEA serum bottle rests on the travertine counter next to a sprig of eucalyptus, slow gentle push-in, the ARDEA lettering crisp.

categories.title: Masks
categories.tagline: Fifteen minutes to calm, hydrate and unwind.
categories.intro: A sheet mask is an intensive boost of hydration and a moment to slow down. Use it two or three evenings a week, after toning and before moisturizer.

benefits.title: Deep hydration
benefits.text: A biocellulose sheet holds more essence against the skin.

benefits.title: Calming
benefits.text: Chamomile and centella help skin look calmer after a long day.

benefits.title: A ritual
benefits.text: Fifteen quiet minutes that make the routine something to look forward to.

howTo.title: Cleanse first
howTo.text: Start with freshly cleansed, slightly damp skin.

howTo.title: Unfold and smooth
howTo.text: Place the mask and smooth out any air bubbles.

howTo.title: Relax 15–20 minutes
howTo.text: Don't leave it on until it dries.

howTo.title: Pat in and moisturize
howTo.text: Press the leftover essence into the skin, then seal with cream.

categories.tip: Keep a mask in the fridge for an extra-cooling effect.

captions.say: Unfold the mask and smooth it on.
Relax for fifteen to twenty minutes.

captions.text: 4  Two or three evenings a week
captions.say: Two or three evenings a week.
